This is the Template ''UtfIcon'' it is good for showing arbitrary UTF character symbols
see e.g.:
* https://www.utf8icons.com/
* https://www.w3schools.com/charsets/ref_utf_symbols.asp
=== usage ===
<pre>{{UtfIcon|utf=✓}}</pre>
{{UtfIcon|utf=✓}}
<pre>{{UtfIcon|utf=🌤|size=24}}</pre>
{{UtfIcon|utf=🌤|size=24}}
<pre>{{UtfIcon|utf=Δ|size=36|color=red}}</pre>
{{UtfIcon|size=36|utf=Δ|color=red}}
<pre>{{UtfIcon|size=48|color=blue|utf=♞}}</pre>
{{UtfIcon|size=48|color=blue|utf=♞}}
<pre>{{UtfIcon|utf=☕|size=96}}</pre>
{{UtfIcon|utf=☕|size=96}}
